name: defaultValue
description: Uncontrolled initial active tab value. Use when you don't need to drive the active tab from parent state.

name: value
description: Controlled active tab value. Pair with onValueChange for fully controlled usage.

name: onValueChange
description: Called whenever the active tab changes. Required for controlled mode.

name: orientation
description: Keyboard navigation axis for the TabsList. Use 'vertical' for sidebars.

name: activationMode
description: When 'automatic', focus activates a tab. When 'manual', focus moves without activation (user must press Enter/Space).

name: children
description: Compose TabsList/TabsTrigger/TabsContent children. Each TabsTrigger and TabsContent must share a unique value string.
